steps.code:
# Fetch all pages of received payment requests and sum amounts within last 7 days
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

access_token = login_result['access_token']
today = datetime.now().date()
start_date = today - timedelta(days=6)  # inclusive of today, so 7 days total
start_datetime = datetime.combine(start_date, datetime.min.time())
end_datetime = datetime.combine(today, datetime.max.time())

total = 0.0
page = 0
while True:
    page_requests = apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=access_token, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not page_requests:
        break
    for req in page_requests:
        created = datetime.fromisoformat(req['created_at'])
        if start_datetime <= created <= end_datetime:
            total += req['amount']
    if len(page_requests) < 20:
        break
    page += 1

print(total)
